title: Offspring genetic diversity regulates rearing experiences that predict differential susceptibility to Chd8 haploinsufficiency.
authors: Tabbaa, Manal; Gamez, Alexis; Dust, A'di; Mataric, Maja; Levitt, Pat
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Chd8单倍剂量不足小鼠的遗传背景与早期养育行为对表型异质性的影响，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Loss-of-function mutations in the autism-associated CHD8 gene are highly penetrant for trait and behavioral abnormalities in children, but there is substantial clinical heterogeneity in the occurrence and extent of disruptions between individuals. Using a large genetic reference panel of mice, we recently showed that this heterogeneity is, in part, regulated by genetic background. Here, we hypothesize that genetic background may also influence early life experiences, further shaping individual susceptibility to neurodevelopmental disorders. To test this, systematic observations were conducted to track behaviors during the rearing of genetically diverse Collaborative Cross offspring raised by genetically identical dams. Biostatistical and machine-learning analyses of the data reveal robust strain-dependent differences in both pup and maternal behaviors that significantly predict sex-specific alterations in body and brain weights, as well as social, anxiety-like, and cognitive trait disruptions following weaning due to Chd8 haploinsufficiency. These results suggest that phenotypic variability in disease models arises from an interaction between inherited mutations and genetically influenced early-life environments. This work highlights the value of incorporating genetic diversity into model systems to better understand the origins of heterogeneity in neurodevelopmental disorders.
abstract_zh: 自闭症相关CHD8基因的功能缺失突变对儿童特征和行为异常具有高度外显性，但个体之间在障碍发生及程度方面存在显著的临床异质性。利用小鼠的大型遗传参考群体，我们近期表明这种异质性部分受遗传背景调控。在此，我们假设遗传背景也可能影响早期生活经历，进一步塑造个体对神经发育障碍的易感性。为验证此假设，我们进行了系统性观察，追踪由遗传相同母鼠抚养的遗传多样性Collaborative Cross后代在养育过程中的行为。对数据的生物统计和机器学习分析揭示了幼崽和母鼠行为中稳健的品系依赖性差异，这些差异显著预测了因Chd8单倍剂量不足导致的断奶后体重和脑重的性别特异性变化，以及社交、焦虑样和认知特征的破坏。这些结果表明，疾病模型中的表型变异源于遗传突变与遗传影响的早期生活环境之间的相互作用。这项工作强调了将遗传多样性纳入模型系统以更好地理解神经发育障碍异质性起源的价值。
